text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — I'm drafting the Q3/Q4 region GPU mix + spot eviction playbook for the EU edge pilot. Questions: 1) H100 vs L40s tradeoffs for 8B-70B workloads, 2) fallback tiers when spot evicts, 3) utilization target & reserve. Proposal: 78% target util, 10% burst reserve. Thoughts?

Ajay Patel: can you drop the cost sheet? need to see $/token assumptions before we pick mix.

Maria Chen: posted the rough calc below, numbers are prototype-level: 
```
H100 (on-demand): $2.35/hr, throughput ~ 900 tok/s for 70B
L40s (reserved): $1.10/hr, throughput ~ 420 tok/s for 70B (quantized)
Spot H100: $0.95/hr (evict risk)
Target: prefer reserved L40s for predictable mid-tail, H100 reserved for high-priority low-latency routes.
```

Drew Kim: eviction playbook thoughts — we should always have a graceful downgrade path: 1) short seq cut (16k -> 8k) 2) route to quantized variant 3) if still congested, route to smaller model family. Also need traffic-shaping knobs per customer.

Sara Lopez: +1 on downgrade path. note: Dedicated customers (reserved contracts) must be isolated — they should never see spot evictions. we need SLA carveouts and an incident-notify window (15 min) to sales/CS.

Maria Chen: agree. carveouts: reserved pools for dedicated customers + a 30s preemption drain for shared pools, and automated notify to account owners on mass-eviction. For public routes we can allow fallback to quantized L40s.

Ajay Patel: one more — can we stage quantized variants on L40s ahead of time so cold-start cost is low? like keep warm caches for top 5% routes.

Maria Chen: yes — staging plan: keep one warm replica per model-size on L40s in each region, KV-cache snapshot restore. if evicted, route to warm quantized replicas.

Drew Kim: ops question — can we automate cooldown after a mass eviction (scale-down + cool-off window) to prevent oscillation? we had flapping last year.

Maria Chen: ops cookbook (draft): 
```
1) detect >5% instance evictions in 2m -> mark region degraded
2) force-route new low-priority requests to fallback pool for 5m
3) suspend autoscale up for 2m to avoid chasing spot churn
4) after 5m, gradually allow autoscale with 1.2x ramp over 10m
5) send notify to SRE/sales via #incidents and emails
```

capacity-bot: Inventory snapshot: EU-edge: 18 reserved L40s, 6 reserved H100, 12 spot H100. projected burn vs commit: -4% this quarter if we migrate 20% traffic to L40 quantized.

Sara Lopez: +customer ask — EMEA fintech pilot needs guaranteed <120ms tail p95 for live chat. can we map that to reserved H100 for those routes?

Maria Chen: yes — launch criteria proposal: 
- SLO: p95 latency < 120ms for prioritized routes
- Utilization: steady-state >= 78% (shared pools)
- Cost: overall $/1M tokens delta <= 15% vs current baseline
- Regression tests: no quality regressions on verification prompts
- Runbook & automated notify in place

Ajay Patel: sounds good. i'll run the cost sims with these constraints and post results by EOD.

Drew Kim: i'll draft the ops playbook PR and include the cooldown knobs.

Maria Chen: awesome. i'll update the roadmap doc (https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/eu-edge-gpu-mix) with these criteria and ping eng-sre + sales for carveouts. :thumbsup:

capacity-bot: Reminder: scheduled procurement check-in tomorrow 10:00am UTC.

Sara Lopez: thanks — will loop in the fintech PM and legal for SLA wording.

Maria Chen: closing loop — action items: Ajay(cost sims), Drew(ops PR), Maria(update doc + stakeholder ping), Sara(SLA wording). back here after EOD numbers.
